paragraphs.source_en: “Well, gentlemen, what do you think?” This question was quickly answered. All agreed to say “Guilty,” as if convinced that Kartinkin had taken part both in the poisoning and the robbery. An old artelshik, \[member of an artel, an association of workmen, in which the members share profits and liabilities\] whose answers were all in favour of acquittal, was the only exception.
